usable_for: text-only generated representative railway-heritage slow-corridor concept
not_usable_for: site facts, existing conditions, resident opinion, boundaries, metrics, approvals or engineering evidence
sources.generation_record: Two distinct flattened assets are included. slow-line-experience.jpg is an unlocated scene regenerated from scratch after visual review rejected ambiguous crossing geometry and a malformed bicycle; its accepted prompt constrains a perpendicular pedestrian crossing, robot behind the stop line, and one mechanically coherent bicycle. The v1.2 replacement slow-line-site-grounded.jpg was generated from a text-only prompt with no input image, site photograph, screenshot, peer image, logo, trademark, private image, identifiable person, or exact camera viewpoint. Its accepted prompt constrains one heritage rail pair and a continuous accessible path in parallel, a perpendicular paved service spur, one robot fully stopped behind the spur line, one mechanically coherent bicycle, a reversible staffed kiosk, physical emergency stop, and analog help. It explicitly rejects documentary/site-survey claims and recognizable government-photo composition.
sources.distribution: Only final flattened JPEG outputs are included under assets/media. Both outputs are explicitly labeled synthetic concepts, not site photographs, existing-condition records, exact sites, or official renderings.
